title: Interactive links and emphasis states
summary: Links (a ↗ mark that opens URLs as written, .draft files in the viewer and file paths in the editor from the git root), the config line with link-base and editor, check suggestions for missing files, static SVG links, and emphasis states (state lines, --state, --states panels and the viewer's state chips) shipped in PR 140 to PR 145 on 2026-10-27, with PR 189 and PR 198 after. The hover chip became the mark as the open button, and PR 441 later removed hover tooltips. Reconciled against f1c6a981; the planning files are at 51269c20.
reason: Byron approved retirement on 2026-11-10 after a check found the work already shipped while the map still said planned.
follow_ups: Several diagrams at once (multi-file sheets or boards, overlays) stays a later question from Byron's memo; start a new initiative when wanted.
Optional: show a link's target without hover tooltips (for example in the status bar on selection), since PR 441 removed the hover tooltip that named it.
